registrationPolicy: Fixed head/body density per group, boot pivot; no scale/alpha breathing. Chaos intentional growth from replicated form only. High-resolution replacement idle cels and retained walk cels register separately to the same head density. Chaos body is sampled from original high-resolution cels at1.34 native density, renderer stays .5; derivatives are explicitly counted separately from independently authored cels.
